title: Creative report: Claude dashboard datasets
description: What report.py --claude-dashboard writes: one array of flat rows per dataset id. x-version is the schema version (the header dataset repeats it); x-key the column or columns that tell rows apart; x-unit currency (the report currency), percent (already times 100), ratio, count, days, date, per-row (the row's own unit column) or text; x-note the sibling column that says why the value is null, so a value is null exactly when its note is set. Metric columns use the metric ids in creative-context/references/metrics.md.

header.description: The report header: one fact per row (title, window, scope, currency, source, attribution, completeness, generated, images, payback metric, ads launched in the window, formats not scored, concepts shown, schema version).

tone.description: Completeness only: ok reconciled, warn short, neutral not checked.

sections.description: Each HTML panel's state as it rendered; why and how to get the data for an empty one.

kpis.description: Key numbers, one row per tile; value is in the unit the row names.

metric.description: A metric or base field id from creative-context/references/metrics.md.

unit.description: The currency code for money, else empty.

value.description: The total for the window: currency for money metrics, percent for rates, ratio for roas and frequency, count otherwise.

value_note.description: Why the paired column is null; null when it has a value.

shown.description: The value as the HTML tile shows it.

change_pct_note.description: Why the paired column is null; null when it has a value.
